A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of HiDe-LLaVA with complete text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Existing content can be matched across pagination and appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original UCIT and CoIN evaluations, CKA analyses, ablations and efficiency measurements in Tables 1-4 and Figures 1-7.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds a Model Tailor comparison and an InternVL-Chat-7B experiment in Appendix D.

M1.justification: The training objective, image/text anchors, similarity-based top-layer LoRA expansion and remaining-layer fusion are unchanged in Equations 1-7 and Algorithm 1. Testing another backbone does not establish a procedural modification.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six UCIT tasks and eight CoIN tasks. The additional Model Tailor and InternVL experiments reuse UCIT coverage; the dataset descriptions and task instructions are retained.

E2.justification: v2 adds Model Tailor as an evaluated UCIT comparator in Appendix D/Table 7. The comparator sets in the original Tables 1-2 remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix D adds evaluation with InternVL-Chat-7B, specifying a 6B visual encoder and 7B Vicuna language model, and tests Model Tailor under sequential UCIT learning. Previously reported LLaVA training settings, dataset splits and metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 8 adds a test of applicability to a second backbone. Existing modality, layer fusion/expansion, coefficient, temperature, task-order and efficiency analyses are retained without substantive changes.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added experiments retain the existing practice of reporting results without uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: New Table 7 reports Model Tailor UCIT Avg/Last scores of 48.39/48.78 alongside retained HiDe-LLaVA scores of 68.94/64.19. Figure 8 adds InternVL results against Zero-shot and Individual references. Original numerical tables and Figures 1-7 are unchanged.

T1.justification: The original mathematical framework is retained. New Appendix B explains the standard linear-kernel CKA calculation through normalized HSIC for an existing analysis; it introduces no new theoretical result, assumption or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: hierarchical decoupling, identifying benchmark leakage, introducing UCIT, and improving continual-learning performance and efficiency. The added experiments do not redefine these main claims.

C2.justification: Appendix D newly suggests repeated parameter recalibration explains Model Tailor's weaker later-task results and interprets the InternVL experiment as confirming architecture-agnostic scalability. Existing limitations concerning fusion degradation and preservation of original model capabilities remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v1 promises future code availability; v2 provides a repository address and states that code and data are released. Appendix B newly documents the existing CKA calculation, while Appendix D identifies the additional backbone's components. Original implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to InternVL, Model Tailor, ChartEdit and ChartCoder. It also distinguishes Model Tailor's original single-task adaptation setting from sequential continual learning, while retaining the principal positioning against existing CIT methods.

P1.justification: Most main-text prose and section organization remain intact. v2 updates affiliations and contact information, adds acknowledgments and two appendix sections, renumbers existing appendices, and reformats baseline descriptions from bullets into paragraphs.

P2.justification: v2 adds comparison Table 7 and radar Figure 8. The original example Table 7 becomes Table 8, and appendix material is redistributed. Existing figures and tables retain their displays apart from limited placement and pagination changes.

improvement.justification: The CKA explanation and code/data access information improve transparency, while the Model Tailor comparison and second-backbone experiment modestly broaden empirical support. The gains are limited: Figure 8 leaves its metric and numerical scale unspecified, and the architecture-agnostic interpretation exceeds what one additional backbone establishes. Overall, the additions provide a modest net quality improvement.
